summary: Build practical utility regulation and tariff setting skills with Excel models, WACC, cost allocation, and rate case exercises. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: Utility regulation and tariff setting explains how allowed revenue is justified and translated into customer prices. For utility, finance, policy, and regulatory professionals, it supports building revenue requirement models, allocating costs across customer classes, and designing tariff structures. Learners use these skills to prepare and explain tariff proposals with evidence on cost drivers, affordability, and service quality.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with utility, finance, policy, or regulatory data and now need stronger capability in price review, revenue setting, and tariff design.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with Microsoft Excel or equivalent spreadsheet software, because several exercises use tariff models and cost allocation templates. Bring familiarity with utility financial data, customer class information, and basic regulatory terminology. The course is suitable for intermediate learners who can work with figures, interpret charts, and follow structured case material.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
